content: {"reasoning":"The denial is for missing required prior authorization, and Silverbridge offers neither retroactive authorization nor peer-to-peer review. A medical-necessity appeal has already been attempted, while resubmission or records would not cure the authorization defect; the patient’s deductible does not make a provider-liability authorization denial billable to the patient. With no valid payer or patient collection path remaining, the balance is uncollectible.","action":"write_off"}
